title: ASTM C 636, Section 2.
officialText:
3.4. Delete Section 2.3.4 and Figure 2 and replace as follows:
2.3.4 If the main runners are supported from the carrying channels by special devices, such devices shall be capable of carrying
four times the design load. The devices shall be load tested by an approved testing agency that shall certify the devices are in
compliance with this code. Such certifications shall be made available to the department and the applicant of record upon request.
